display.title: Yud-Beis Tammuz: The Frierdiker Rebbe Set Free
display.summary_short: A short word on Yud-Beis Tammuz: the Frierdiker Rebbe was sentenced to death for teaching Torah and miraculously freed, and the day is celebrated by Jews around the world.
display.summary_long: A brief Yud-Beis Tammuz announcement from the Tzivos Hashem radio show in 5742. Uncle Yossi tells children that 55 years earlier, the Frierdiker Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn, was ready to give his life to teach Torah to his many students, and for this he was arrested and sentenced to death. By a miracle from Hashem his life was spared and he was set free. That is why Jewish communities all over the world make the day of his release a day of gathering, retelling the stories of his freedom and learning his teachings on serving Hashem with all one's heart and soul. This Shabbos is the twelfth of Tammuz, which is also the Frierdiker Rebbe's birthday.
display.lesson: The Frierdiker Rebbe's mesiras nefesh for Torah teaches us to serve Hashem with all our heart and soul.
